US F-16 fighter jet crashes in Germany during training

A U.S. F-16 fighter jet crashed near the Spangdahlem air base in western Germany during a routine training flight. The pilot ejected safely. This is the second U.S. F-16 crash in less than a week. The cause of the crash is currently unknown, and a major emergency response was prompted.
